reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V1 (agent's declared best): KS yaw-rate (v/L)*tan(delta) with canonical per-platform wheelbase L (2.984 m Mach-E, 3.70 m F-150 Lightning from agent's parameters.py) minus per-segment straight-only mean bias (samples with |delta|<0.01, requiring >5 such samples).
notes: Agent's REPORT.md declares V1 as best ('Best shipped variant is V1'). Agent originally scored only 40 Mach-E segments at v_mps>2.0 implicit (no filter mention) — here pooled across ALL 545 canonical Ford segments with v_mps>2.0 filter. Per-segment straight-bias is computed per segment from that segment's own straight samples (matches agent's pipeline). Baseline recomputed delta from cached: +0.000e+00.
